module: Node "Closest Road" (repeat_instant). Finds the navgraph road closest to a position (map.findClosestRoad) and returns the two segment nodes (the closest first), the distance, the road width and the projected point. Input: pos (vec3). Outputs: name_a, pos_a, name_b, pos_b, dist, and hidden pins roadId/roadIdx a/b, exists, width, projectedPoint. Only recomputes if pos changes.
notes: Bug in findDecalroad: the test "if not idId" uses a nonexistent variable (idId instead of rdId), so the lookup by name is always attempted even when the number was read.
findDecalroad returns nothing (nil) when the name does not start with "DecalRoad": roadId/roadIdx are then nil.
If the name exists in scenetree, it returns -1,-1 (the branch test is inverted compared to the comment).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

findDecalroad.desc: For a compound node name "DecalRoad<id>_<index>", returns the DecalRoad id and the point index; returns -1,-1 if an object with that name exists in scenetree; nil otherwise.

work.desc: If pos has changed, looks for the closest road, orders the nodes by proximity, fills the pins (positions, DecalRoad ids, distance, projected point, width = 2 × interpolated radius) and exists. Sets exists to false if nothing is found.
